parameters.description: Points to a variable in which MiniportISR returns whether the network adapter actually generated the interrupt. MiniportISR sets this to TRUE if it detects that the interrupt came from the network adapter designated at MiniportAdapterContext . If its network adapter shares an IRQ with other devices on the same bus, MiniportISR should return FALSE as quickly as possible whenever it determines that the network adapter did not interrupt.

parameters.description: Points to a variable that MiniportISR sets to TRUE if the MiniportHandleInterrupt function should be called to complete the interrupt-driven I/O operation.
